QUOTE: The allow list is consulted only at the approval gate.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list is consulted only at the approval gate (`check_approval`, tool_executor.cpp) and that allow "lets the call pass approval. It does not bypass the MCP keys or tier checks." Deny is a separate check in `server_manager.cpp`, so the allow list is in a different file and does not grant execution.
